text: Men Nulaali ado maa an Nulaaɗo, si wanaa worɓe ɓanndikooɓe ɓe wonaa malaa'ika, Meɗen wahyo e maɓɓe wano Men wahayirta e ma. Ɓen ko jeyaaɓe e yimɓe ca'e ɗen ɓe jeyaaka e yimɓe buruure, yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen fenni ɓe, Men halki ɓen. E ɓee fennooɓe ma yahaali ka leydi, ɓe taskoo ko honno battane fennooɓe adinooɓe ɓen wa'unoo, ɓe waaji- waajitora ɓen? Pellet ko ko woni kon ka saare laa- laakara e neemaaji, ɓuri moƴƴannde ɓen hulunoo- hulunooɓe Alla aduna. E on haqqiltaa wonnde ko ɗum ɓuri moƴƴude, huliron Alla ɗoftagol yamirooje Makko ɗen -ɓuri mawnude e majje woni gomɗinal- woɗɗitoɗon haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin -ɓuri mawnude a majji woni sirkangol Alla.
